candidates.snippet: 1849: Enters Prussian Landtag - Bismarck was elected to the Prussian Landtag, marking his entry into national politics. 1862: Appointed Minister-President of Prussia - Bismarck became the chief minister of Prussia, wielding significant power over domestic and foreign policy. 1871: Proclaims German Empire - Bismarck orchestrated the unification of Germany, proclaiming the German Empire at Versailles. 1890: Resigns as Chancellor - Bismarck resigned from his post as Chancellor after a disagreement with the new Kaiser Wilhelm II.
